name: Hell Salamander
description: A versatile Balance type that can be assembled in two modes — 5-Blade Mode for stamina and smooth rotation, or 10-Blade Mode for raw attack power. It can spin both clockwise and counterclockwise, making it adaptable against many opponents.

ability.name: Dual Spin
ability.description: Hell Salamander can be assembled in 5-Blade Mode for more stamina and smoother rotation, or 10-Blade Mode for more attack power and stronger hits. It can spin both clockwise and counterclockwise, making it versatile against many opponents.

special_move.name: Salamander Claw
special_move.description: Hell Salamander rushes the opponent with a flurry of powerful slashing attacks.
flavour_texts: 🔥 **Salamander Claw** — Hell Salamander rushes in with slashing claws!

special_move_2.name: Burning Salamander
special_move_2.description: Hell Salamander surrounds itself with fiery energy and delivers repeated burning strikes.
flavour_texts: 🔥 **Burning Salamander** — fiery energy surrounds Hell Salamander!
